mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Change an existing ABAP object: write the new source code of a class, program, CDS view or another type.

description: Writes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …) under its lock: sends the one write request of its type under lock_handle, the lock handle of the object, and answers SAP's result. The write sets the whole content to the one given. lock_handle and object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, source_code*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, ddl_code*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, ddl_source*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, source_code*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, source_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, test_class_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, local_types_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, definitions_code*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, macros_code*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, test_class_source*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, source_code*, transport_request) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*, source_code*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(class_name*, implementation_code*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(name*, source_code*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, desired_publication_state*, binding_variant*, service_name, service_version). For PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT and FUNCTION_GROUP, source_code is the whole metadata document, sent as given. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST and BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, lock_handle is the class's lock handle. For SERVICE_BINDING the write is its publication request, sent under the lock_handle given, an empty one included; service_name and service_version (default 0001) name the service of an OData V2 binding. transport_request is sent as the write's corrNr. Over Streamable HTTP the write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); the write is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds. When lock_handle is given and object_type is one of DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, FUNCTION_GROUP, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST, CDS_UNIT_TEST, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or lock_handle is given and object_type is PACKAGE and the connection is HTTP, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code (for TABLE/STRUCTURE update).

ddl_name.description: DDL source name (CDS view, AMDP table function, etc.).

ddl_source.description: Complete DDL source code (for DDL update).

definitions_code.description: Updated source for class local definitions.

local_types_code.description: Updated source for class local types.

lock_handle.description: The lock handle of the object (for a class include, of the class): the write is sent under it.

macros_code.description: Updated source for class local macros.

name.description: Object name for handlers that require a generic `name` (behavior definition, metadata extension).

object_type.description: ABAP object type for routed compact operation.

service_name.description: Published service name (SERVICE_BINDING, an OData V2 binding).

service_version.description: Published service version (SERVICE_BINDING, an OData V2 binding). Default 0001.

source_code.description: The content written: the source, or for PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT and FUNCTION_GROUP the whole metadata document.

test_class_code.description: Updated source for the local test class.

test_class_source.description: ABAP source of the local test classes (UNIT_TEST and CDS_UNIT_TEST update).

transport_request.description: Transport request id, sent as the write's corrNr (the types whose description names it).

name: HandlerUpdate
